login.title: Masjid Admin
login.lead: Assalamu Alaikum. Log in with your phone’s screen lock.
login.screenLockHint: Your phone will ask for your screen lock (PIN, pattern, face or fingerprint).
login.trouble: Having trouble? Contact the Masjid Connect team
login.failed: Login didn’t work. Please try again.
login.cancelled: Login was cancelled. Tap “Log in” to try again.
login.noScreenLock: Your phone needs a screen lock to log in. Set one in your phone’s settings, then try again.
login.sessionEnded: You were logged out. Please log in again.
